answer: Timber-raft dawn peer-audit bond: each identity moors a timber raft on the river, locking 70 credit. At dawn each raft files a river-flow reading; a random peer auditor replays it on the public flow table within 3%. A copied reading burns the bond; an auditor passing a fake loses 25 stake. First audit 30, k-th 30+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,526,500 plus 70,000 locked. Rented rafts fail: one key signs one reading. An honest rafter pays 30 once.
